issues.description: filters='*.exe' on the file picker breaks Linux and macOS users
issues.detail: conda/mamba/micromamba binaries are extensionless on POSIX systems. Hardcoding '*.exe' means non-Windows users see an empty file picker. Either platform-gate the filter or drop it entirely, since validate_conda already enforces correctness.

issues.description: validate_conda substring match on --version output accepts unrelated binaries
issues.detail: `any(tool in out.decode().lower() ...)` matches substrings anywhere in stdout, so any binary printing 'conda'/'mamba'/'micromamba' anywhere passes. Match the leading token of the version string or check the basename to actually establish identity.

issues.description: setFocus() side effect added to shared create_browsefile helper changes behavior for all callers
issues.detail: create_browsefile is shared infrastructure used across Spyder preference pages. Adding edit.setFocus() after select_file changes focus behavior for every caller, not just the new conda field. Move the focus call to the caller that needs it.

issues.description: validate_conda complects multiple checks and lies about the empty-string case
issues.detail: The function folds 'is path empty', 'is it an executable file', and 'does --version mention conda' into one ambiguous boolean, with empty returning True. The UI layer should decide that empty means 'unset'; the validator should answer one question and answer it honestly.

issues.description: Redundant 'custom_conda' boolean complects the override decision with the path value
issues.detail: argv() now consults auto-discovery, the custom_conda flag, and the conda_path string as three sources of truth. The boolean adds no information the non-empty path doesn't already carry. Drop custom_conda and treat a non-empty conda_path as the override.

issues.description: validate_conda runs a subprocess on every keystroke and discards the Popen handle
issues.detail: If wired to textChanged, each keystroke spawns conda --version, blocking the UI for hundreds of ms and leaking pipes since the Popen handle is dropped without checking returncode. Debounce to editingFinished/focus-out and bind the process to a variable for clean teardown.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small, well-scoped feature that ships with sloppy validation and a few cross-cutting hygiene issues. The validator's substring match on --version output is too loose to actually establish that a binary is conda/mamba/micromamba, and the Windows-only '*.exe' file filter breaks the picker on macOS and Linux. Shared infrastructure (create_browsefile) grew a setFocus side effect that affects every caller, and the new 'custom_conda' boolean is redundant with the path value. Validator design also folds multiple checks into one ambiguous boolean and runs an expensive subprocess on every keystroke. No P0 blockers — fix the validator, fix the filter, move the focus call, then land.
